items.label: Media / MPRIS now-playing
items.reason: Full title/artist/artUrl JSON at 22 ms; daily glance + transport controls; medianotch proves demand.

items.label: Notifications + DND
items.sample: off; 10 history files; newest {"summary":"T7 unmounted"}; notifications.json {"version":3,"dnd":false}
items.reason: DND chip + unread count is a top daily status; history dir is a free ticker source.

items.label: Clipboard history depth
items.reason: Depth chip + one-click open of the existing clipboard overlay; zero new backend needed.

items.label: Screenshot / record / OCR / colour picker
items.read_cmd: ls -t ~/Pictures/screenshots 2>/dev/null | head -1 (grim, slurp, tesseract, hyprpicker all installed)
items.sample: grim+slurp+tesseract+hyprpicker present; no recorder running (pgrep wf-recorder empty)
items.action_cmd: omarchy-capture-screenshot (region: omarchy-capture-region; OCR: omarchy-capture-text; colour: hyprpicker)
items.reason: Four dock buttons for daily capture flows; read side is just last-screenshot thumbnail.

items.label: Night light (hyprsunset)
items.reason: Evening toggle; cheap IPC read; pairs with DND/coffee as env-state chip.

items.label: Idle inhibit / stay-awake (coffee)
items.reason: Stay-awake flag is a daily presentation/recording toggle; rich timer JSON included.

items.label: Power profile
items.reason: Desktop on AC so mostly static, but one-click perf/saver switch is handy under load.

items.label: Audio sink volume + switch
items.sample: Volume: 0.95 (default: CORSAIR Slipstream receiver; Ryzen analog + HDMI also present)
items.reason: Volume is touched many times a day; 8 ms read; sink cycle covers headset/HDMI swaps.

items.label: Microphone mute state
items.reason: Call-heavy days need a visible mic state; same cheap wpctl read as volume.

items.label: Bluetooth power + devices
items.sample: Name: OmarchyLink, Powered: yes; 0 connected, 0 paired devices
items.reason: Radio on with zero paired devices on this box; low daily value until peripherals appear.

items.label: Network link (ethernet/wifi)
items.reason: Collector already feeds net_rx/net_tx/net_if/net_addr; link-state chip adds little over the trace.

items.label: VPN / Tailscale
items.sample: (empty; tailscale and nordvpn CLIs not installed, tailscaled/nordvpnd units absent; omarchy.tailscale plugin disabled)
items.reason: No VPN or tailnet on this machine today; skip until one is installed.

items.label: Keyboard layout
items.reason: Single-layout user; only useful if a second layout is ever added.

items.label: Weather
items.action_cmd: omarchy-shell omarchy.weather toggle (panel; edit location via omarchy-weather-location)
items.reason: Collector already emits a weather key every 15 min; HUD just never renders it. Free win.

items.label: Calendar / agenda
items.sample: September 2026 grid, today = Mon 28 (no khal/calcurse installed, no event source)
items.action_cmd: omarchy-shell omarchy.clock toggle (calendar panel); install khal for real agenda
items.reason: Only a bare month grid exists; real agenda needs a calendar backend that is not installed.

items.label: Reminders / timers
items.action_cmd: omarchy-reminder 25 "pomodoro break" (overlay: omarchy-shell shell call omarchy.reminders toggle {})
items.reason: Active-count chip doubles as a pomodoro timer via minute-based reminders; no extra daemon.

items.label: System updates
items.sample: 2 (aether 4.29.8->4.30.0, mise-bin 2026.9.7->2026.9.14); Omarchy is up to date
items.reason: Collector already emits pkg_updates every 15 min; badge + click-to-update is a classic dock item.

items.label: Disk usage
items.reason: fs_root_pct and the blk device tree already render on DP-2; only a free-space chip is missing.

items.label: Trash
items.action_cmd: gio trash --empty (confirm first); open: gio open trash://
items.reason: Nice-to-have count chip; emptying is rare and destructive so rank low.

items.label: Recent downloads
items.reason: Fresh-file strip is genuinely handy after browser downloads; trivial cost.

items.label: Workspace / window overview
items.action_cmd: qs ipc -p /usr/share/omarchy/shell -t expose call toggle '' (Exposé overlay, v5.0.0)
items.reason: WINDOWS/NAV panel exists on HDMI-A-3; adding an Exposé launch button closes the loop.

items.label: Lock / suspend / reboot
items.reason: A session button cluster is standard dock fare; lock state itself is near-static.

items.label: Theme + background
items.sample: Hackerman (font JetBrainsMono Nerd Font; channel stable; omarchy 4.0.4-1)
items.reason: Collector emits theme_name but v3 never shows it; chip + next-wallpaper button is cheap.

items.label: Omarchy menu
items.reason: One launcher button gives the HUD access to every other Omarchy action; no polling needed.

items.label: Display brightness (DDC)
items.reason: Three external monitors via DDC; step buttons beat opening the monitor panel.

items.label: Agents (omarchy.agents)
items.sample: ok (bar widget enabled; collector already emits ag_* per-agent CPU and aguse* token keys)
items.reason: Agent CPU/token data already streams; the stock widget's next/refresh cycle is the missing action.

items.label: Screensaver
items.reason: Idle service already auto-runs it at 150 s; a manual launch button is near-zero value.

items.label: Network speedtest
items.sample: summary: Measure live internet speed for one direction (disk variant: omarchy-disk-speedtest)
items.reason: On-demand action only; a button is fine but there is nothing to poll.
